comment.zh:
Electerm 是一款开源跨平台的终端 / SFTP 客户端，支持 SSH、SFTP 文件传输。

既能当 SSH 终端，也能在文件传输里当 SFTP 客户端：账号密码由客户端通过命令行参数自动代填，无需手工输入。Electerm 需安装v5.11.8以上。

!!!手动下载安装，点击保存启用!!!
comment.en:
Electerm is an open-source cross-platform terminal/SFTP client supporting SSH and SFTP file transfer.

It works both as an SSH terminal and as an SFTP client for file transfers: the username and password are passed on the command line by the client, so there is nothing to type. Electerm requires version 5.11.8 or higher.

!!!Manually download and install, click Save to activate!!!
